noSectionPermissions: Nothing to show — you have admin access but no section permissions yet.

review.loadFailed: Failed to load the review queue.
review.submitFailed: Failed to submit the decision — try again.

notes.title: Moderator notes
notes.intro: Internal history on this member. Only people with access to Users can see it; the member never does.

gates.autoOpen: Auto-open on a schedule (opens regardless of the switch above once due)

signups.copiedFor: Invite link copied to clipboard — ready to send to {{email}}.
signups.revokeBody: {{email}} won't be able to use their invite link anymore. You can grant them access again later if you change your mind.

roles.intro: Roles bundle permissions. Assign them to users from the Users page.

search.label: Search roles
search.placeholder: Name, what it can do, or a policy…

roles.nameHint: Uppercase letters, numbers and dashes, e.g. TRUST-SAFETY-LEAD
roles.createFailed: Failed to create role — name may already be taken.
roles.systemLocked: System role — holds every permission and cannot be edited.

permissions.label: Permissions
permissions.searchPlaceholder: Search permissions, e.g. edit users, timeout…

policies.intro: Idle-timeout templates attached to roles, 2 weeks at most. A role without one gets the full 2 weeks.
policies.title: New session policy
policies.description: A named idle-timeout template you can attach to roles, from 1 minute to 2 weeks. A user holding several roles is bound by whichever attached policy is shortest.
policies.createFailed: Failed to create session policy — name may already be taken, or the duration is out of range (1 minute to 2 weeks).

reports.intro: Reports members filed about a circle or someone in it. Open one to read the conversation around the moment it was filed, then record a decision with your reasoning. Look a member up in Users to act on an account.
reports.withheld: Withheld by moderation — only its author saw this
reports.noMessages: Nothing was said in this circle.
reports.decisionIntro: Write down your reasoning first. It is kept with the report as the record of why, and is required before you can decide.
reports.notePlaceholder: What you found in the conversation and why you are deciding this way…
reports.decideFailed: Failed to save the decision — it may already have been decided by someone else.
reports.removed: Removed by a moderator after a report

note.label: Note on the member
note.hint: Your reasoning is saved to their moderator-only history, visible under Users.

warn.label: Warn the member
warn.hint: Sends them a message from the moderation team.

remove_from_session.label: Remove from this circle
remove_from_session.hint: They can no longer read or post in this circle. Their account is untouched.

hide_messages.label: Hide the reported messages
hide_messages.hint: Other members stop seeing them; the author sees them marked as removed.

ban.label: Ban the member
ban.hint: Their sign-in is refused from now on and their current session ends. The reported messages are kept as evidence.

reports.memberMessageHint: They will read this. Your reasoning above stays internal.
reports.memberMessagePlaceholder: What they should know, and what we expect going forward…
reports.banWarning: A ban is permanent and applies to every sign-in identity linked to this member.

history.title: History
history.none: Nothing on file about the members this report is about.
history.selectPrompt: Select a report on the left to see it here.

outcomes.title: Outcomes
outcomes.none: No outcomes yet. Add one to act on a member or on the reported messages; add several to treat members differently.

reports.decisionApply_one: Apply {{count}} outcome and close the report
reports.decisionApply_other: Apply {{count}} outcomes and close the report
reports.decisionDismiss: Dismiss the report — nothing needs doing
reports.decisionHintNoOutcomes: Add at least one outcome to act on this report, or dismiss it if nothing needs doing.
reports.decisionHintWithOutcomes: To dismiss instead, remove the outcomes above.
